title: Atlas Ownership
text: Atlas is operated by the Platform Reliability team.

title: Platform Reliability Production Storage
text: Platform Reliability maintains Borealis for production customer-profile storage.

title: Borealis Production Backup Policy
text: Production Borealis incremental backups run every six hours.

title: Borealis Production Backup Policy — Previous Revision
text: Production Borealis incremental backups run every twelve hours. This was the previous production backup policy before the current six-hour cadence.

title: Aurora Backup Policy
text: Aurora, a legacy reporting storage system, performs incremental backups every twelve hours.

title: Developer Productivity Worker Platform
text: Developer Productivity maintains Cirrus for production asynchronous workloads.

title: Cirrus Retry Policy
text: Production Cirrus retries failed jobs at most five times before dead-letter handling.

title: Cirrus Production Retry Policy — Pending Revision
text: Production Cirrus failed jobs use a retry limit of three attempts under the pending retry-policy revision. The revision has not yet taken effect.

title: Payroll Operations
text: Payroll Operations manages monthly salary processing and tax statements.
